podcast.body: This song was Kelly Clarkson's "idol coronation song," released in October 2002, barely a month after she won the first season of "American Idol." It debuted in the middle of the Hot 100, charted entirely on radio airplay for two weeks, and then hurtled from number 52 to number one in its third week, beating The Beatles' record for the biggest leap to the top. This marked a unique entry for an "American Idol" winner, as she was popular enough to get early radio spins, preventing an instant number one debut based solely on sales. "Clarkson's idol coronation song, A Moment Like This, debuted in the middle of the hot 100."
